content.text: •expect pregnancy when ≥1wk has passed w/o onset of expected menses
biparietal diameter (BPD), head circumference (HC), abdominal circumference (AC), femur length (FL)
effacement causes release of blood-tinged mucus plug, “bloody show”
•pushing begins once cervix 10cm dilated & 100% effaced & presenting part has descended
arrest of labor as cervix ≥6cm w/ ROM

: cervix stretching sends nerve impulses to hypothalamus → posterior pituitary releases oxytocin → results in more vigorous uterus contraction; after delivery, ↓ cervical stretching → breaks +feedback cycle
, evaluate q30min during stage 1 & q15min during stage 2
q2h during stage 1 once in active phase
*inadequate descent associated w/ hypocontractile uterus & is indication for oxytocin
: pre-eclampsia/eclampsia, HELLP, diabetes, chronic HTN, heart disease
: late-term, fetal abnormality, chorioamnionitis, PROM, placental insufficiency, oligohydramnios, IUGR, fetal demise, multiple gestation
: contracted pelvis, placenta previa, vasa previa, previous cesarean, myomectomy entering endometrial cavity, transverse lie
*cervix favorability for labor induction, predicts success of induction
